#### `stc.relics.yubikey.enable`

Whether to enable YubiKey system support (pcscd + udev rules).

- **Type:** boolean
- **Default:** `false`
- **Example:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/yubikey.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/yubikey.nix)
